reason: A DSH web plugin that locally aggregates session token usage and presents it in a persistent draggable widget with totals, time-series charts, and heatmaps.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 网页中本地统计会话 Token 用量，并通过可拖动悬浮窗展示总量、趋势曲线和热力图。
summaries.en: A DSH web plugin that locally aggregates session token usage and displays totals, trend charts, and heatmaps in a draggable floating widget.

capabilities: Reads local DSH session usage logs
Aggregates token usage in process memory
Serves aggregated snapshots through a same-origin local HTTP API
Displays an interactive draggable browser overlay with charts
Stores widget position and display state in browser localStorage
